newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P affirms Alcatel Australia rating.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P affirms Alcatel Australia rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday it had affirmed the A1 plus short term rating of Alcatel Alsthom Finance Ltd and the A plus long term rating of Alcatel Australia Ltd.
The ratings agency also said it removed the ratings from creditwatch with negative implications, where they were placed on September 23.

It said the decisions follow similar action on the ratings of parent Alcatel Alsthom SA and follows the recent choice by the French Government of Lagardere as the buyer for Thomson SA, a company which Alcatel was bidding for.
S&P said the rating outlook for Alcatel Australia was negative.
